D5/S3/QuantumChannels/ProjectionDiagnost.name: D5.S3.QuantumChannels.ProjectionDiagnostics.MonitoredSpectralMean.monitored_spectral_mean
D5/S3/QuantumChannels/ProjectionDiagnost.signature: theorem monitored_spectral_mean (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E) (v : E) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) : (occupiedSpectrum U v).Finite ∧ (occupiedSpectrum U v).ncard = Module.finrank ℂ (cyclicSpace U v) ∧ HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n + 1 : ℝ) * returnProbability U v (n + 1)) ((occupiedSpectrum U v).ncard : ℝ) ∧ HasSum (fun n : ℕ => returnProbability U v (n + 1)) 1
